subject: Community repair event details
text: Good morning, This follows up on our message from two days ago regarding the upcoming community repair event. To clarify the arrangements: doors open at quarter to ten, opening remarks begin at quarter past ten, and the workshop sessions run until three in the afternoon. Please arrive by ten o'clock so the room can be set aside without delay. The entrance on the east side of the library will be open. Tea, coffee, and simple refreshments will be provided near the noticeboard. There is no formal registration, but a headcount would be appreciated by Wednesday if possible. If you need access support, please mention this before Thursday so seating can be adjusted. We hope the plan is clear, and we are happy to answer any further questions. The library staff have confirmed that coat pegs and a small table for materials will be available. If you bring tools or parts, please label them lightly and use only the taped area. The closing discussion will return there again briefly.
